title: Quote cache
context: Adds an in-memory cache in front of the price service, so the quote endpoint stops calling it on every request. QuoteCache is a Spring singleton used by all request threads.

issues.title: HashMap shared across threads
issues.why: The bean is a singleton, so every request thread reads and writes the same HashMap. Concurrent puts can corrupt it or lose entries.
issues.fix: Use ConcurrentHashMap, or a real cache such as Caffeine.

issues.title: Check-then-act race
issues.why: Two threads can both see the key missing and both call the price service. That's the stampede the cache was meant to stop.

issues.title: Non-atomic counter
issues.why: hits++ is a read-modify-write. Concurrent increments get lost, and without volatile other threads may not see the new value.
issues.fix: AtomicInteger, LongAdder, or a Micrometer counter.

issues.title: No expiry or size limit
issues.why: Prices change every second, but entries never expire, so users get stale quotes forever. The map also grows with every ticker ever requested.
issues.fix: Add a TTL (a few seconds for prices) and a maximum size; Caffeine handles both.

issues.title: Second lookup can miss

why.java: If clear() runs between the put and the final get, the method returns null even though it just fetched a quote.
why.kotlin: If clear() runs between the put and the final read, !! throws a NullPointerException even though a quote was just fetched.

issues.fix: Return the local value (or the computeIfAbsent result) instead of reading the map again.
